diagnosis: The lone decision-maker was able to satisfy checks C2 and C4 because the settlement included the exact values for the 'confidential_segment_minutes' (30) and 'remote_live_video' (true), which were specified in PF1 and PF2 respectively. These exact values allowed the decision-maker to meet the requirements without needing the hidden information.

C4.why: The remote employees' caregiving schedule changes the start time to exactly 11:00 and changes the participation decision to require both live video access and recorded summaries for absences.
